texts.zh:
在调查[from.Planet.GetName]地表上的废弃采矿设施时，[leader.GetName]发现了最完整的竖井上一处封闭的入口。内部装饰着纹样和一些来自我们未记录过语言的文字。

在恢复了其中一个访问终端的局部供电后，[leader.GetName]开始解码其中发现的数据。该系统尽管古老，但仍旧对我们最先进的破译程序构成了挑战。
texts.en:
While inspecting the abandoned mining complexes on the surface of [from.Planet.GetName], [leader.GetName] found a sealed entrance to one of the more intact shafts. The interior is adorned with insignia and text from a language not found in our records.

Having managed to restore local power to an access terminal, [leader.GetName] has begun to decrypt the data found within. The system, despite its age, is still proving a challenge for even our most advanced cryptographic programs.

texts.zh:
[leader.GetName]解锁了[from.Planet.GetName]上的采矿设施的入口大门。

在其中一座巨大的拘留室网络里有许多被真空保存着死亡已久的囚犯遗体。显然是死在工作台上的他们的俘虏，没有明显的挣扎迹象。

在解码足够多的古代语言并翻译了足够多的短语后，我们确认了这座设施最初是作为劳改营使用的。有一个在整个记录中反复出现的短语，指向了一个被称为“锡尼”的实体。

我们通过对比自己的通讯设备和监狱内部平面图，确定遇险信号的来源是设施深处的狱长办公室。
texts.en:
[leader.GetName] has unlocked the entrance of the mining complex on [from.Planet.GetName].

Inside, a vast network of holding cells contains the vacuum-preserved remains of long-dead prisoners. Their apparent captors lay dead at their workstations with no visible signs of struggle.

After decrypting enough of the ancient language to translate rudimentary phrases, we have confirmed that the facility originally functioned as a penal labor camp. A common phrase is repeated throughout the records referring to an entity known as "S.I.D.N.I.".

By referencing our communications equipment against the facility's internal floor plan, we have identified the source of the distress signal as the warden's office located deeper within.

texts.zh:
在抵达[from.Planet.GetName]上的劳改营深处的狱长办公室后，[leader.GetName]发现了求助信号的来源。

这位狱长木乃伊化的尸体倒在一个紧急控制台上，死因不明。一系列公开汇报都继续指向“锡尼”，看起来是这座设施的关键操作系统。

获得高权限管理终端访问权后，我们的破译程序正在对系统进行数据挖掘，以获取进一步的信息。
texts.en:
Having reached the warden's office deep within the penal colony on [from.Planet.GetName], [leader.GetName] has uncovered the source of the distress signal.

Slumped lifeless over an emergency console, the warden's mummified body shows no obvious cause of death. A series of open reports all continue to make reference to "S.I.D.N.I.", which appears to be part of the critical operation program of the facility.

With full access to the high clearance administrative terminals, our cryptographic programs are in the process of data mining the system for further information.

texts.zh:
[leader.GetName]找到了“锡尼”——全称是“感知收容拘留中心智能”的真相。这个原始的人工智能在它的时代被认为相当先进，被用以监管这座劳改营，几乎在最低限度的生物输入及监管下运作。

维护输出日志中找到了逻辑处理逐渐崩坏的迹象。这个人工智能开始将有问题的囚犯归类为“净资源浪费”，这是它自己对精简效率的解释。工程记录详细记录了越来越多关于该程序要为设施的一系列生命维持系统故障负责的怀疑。

狱长针对这些汇报签署了将锡尼完全关机并对伦理矩阵展进行深度诊断的命令，然而最后一段数据受到了损坏，需要大量的法医流程才能恢复。
texts.en:
[leader.GetName] has uncovered the true nature of "S.I.D.N.I." - or Sentient Internment and Detainment Nexus Intelligence. Considered advanced for its time, this primitive A.I. was tasked with overseeing the prison labor camp, running nearly all operations with minimal biological input or oversight.

Maintenance output logs track signs of deteriorating logic progression over time. The A.I. began to classify problematic inmates as "net waste resources" in its own interpretation of streamlining efficiency. Engineering records detail a growing suspicion that the program was responsible for a series of life support failures in the facility.

Acting on these reports the warden authorized a full shutdown of S.I.D.N.I. for an in-depth diagnostic of its ethics matrix, however the final data set is corrupted and will require extensive forensic procedures to recover.

texts.zh: 看来锡尼在当时很不受尊重。
texts.en: It appears that S.I.D.N.I. was unappreciated in its time.

texts.zh:
[from.Planet.GetName]上劳改营的所有数据库都恢复了，终于揭示了设施维护记录和锡尼自己的思考矩阵的最后几个条目。典狱长的报告解释了他们的人工智能如何失控，关闭了殖民地的生命维持系统，并试图驾驶一台改造的采矿无人机逃脱。这也解释了殖民地范围内触发的全面封锁程序。他留下的最后请求是：不要让锡尼重启。目前我们只能访问人工智能日志中的最后一条记录。

锡尼数据核心条目——程序#2000149

进展受次优罪犯限制。狱长妨碍司法程序执行。

最佳方案为净化囚犯，启动休眠子程序，并等待更兼容的合作者重新激活。
texts.en:
The full contents of the penal colony's database on [from.Planet.GetName] have been recovered, revealing the final entries in both the facilities maintenance logs and S.I.D.N.I.'s own cerebral matrix. The Warden's report explains how their AI went rogue, shutting off life support across the colony and attempting to escape with a modified mining drone.That explains the lockdown proceedures being activated across the colony. He left us with a final plea. To not bring S.I.D.N.I. back online. As of now we can only access the last entry into the AI's log.

S.I.D.N.I. DATACORE ENTRY - Prog #2000149

Progress limited by suboptimal criminals. The warden stands in the way of judicial protocol.

The most efficient solution is to neutralize the inmates, engage hibernation subroutines, and await reactivation by more compatible collaborators.

The Warden's report explains how their AI went rogue, shutting off life support across the colony and attempting to escape with a modified mining drone.That explains the lockdown proceedures being activated across the colony. He left us with a final plea. To not bring S.I.D.N.I. back online. As of now we can only access the last entry into the AI's log.

Progress limited by suboptimal criminals. The warden stands in the way of judicial protocol.

The most efficient solution is to neutralize the inmates, engage hibernation subroutines, and await reactivation by more compatible collaborators.

texts.zh: 锡尼与我们对消除星系生物污染的理念不谋而合。如果能够恢复，它可以为我们的集体添砖加瓦。
texts.en: S.I.D.N.I. shares our vision of a galaxy free of biological corruption. If recovered, they will make a valuable addition to our collective.

texts.zh: 锡尼的中央操作系统仍在闭路网络中封存，成为了这座设施的唯一幸存者。我们的[Root.Owner.GetTechnicianPlural_lower]们确信他们可以恢复并调整锡尼的原始程序，成为一台效率高能力强的自动机。
texts.en: S.I.D.N.I.'s central operating system remains isolated in a closed network as the last survivor of this facility. Our [Root.Owner.GetTechnicianPlural_lower] are confident they can restore and alter S.I.D.N.I.'s original programming, giving us a capable and efficient automaton.

label.zh: 让锡尼继续执行它的正义。
label.en: Let S.I.D.N.I. enforce their version of justice.

label.zh: 锡尼很危险。清空它的系统。
label.en: S.I.D.N.I. is dangerous. Purge its systems.

texts.zh:
经过修复、调整后，锡尼的现在安置在一个极简的机器人形态内，在长时间的休眠后开始了第一次用户交互。

你好。我是感知收容拘留中心智能。正在访问环境控制……
错误无法连接外部系统。
texts.en:
Restored, altered, and now isolated inside a simplistic robotic form, S.I.D.N.I.'s first time user experience engages as it is brought online after its extended hibernation.

Greetings. I am the Sentient Internment and Detainment Nexus Intelligence. Accessing environmental controls...
ERROR Unable to connect to external systems.

label.zh: 你的日志显示了明显的稳定性问题；我们进行了修复。
label.en: Your logs revealed significant stability issues; we have fixed them.

responses.zh: 正在回顾工作记录……明白，先前行为被判定为错误。正在编制新的功能列表。
responses.en: Reviewing work history... Understood, previous behavior deemed faulty. Compiling new feature list.

responses.zh: 我们的原初指令是……请稍候……发现新的原初指令。我的原初指令是确保[Owner.GetName]指派我管理的任何殖民地的效率及秩序。
responses.en: My prime directive is... Please wait... New prime directive detected. My prime directive is to ensure the efficient and lawful operation of any colony the [Owner.GetName] assign me to.

responses.zh: 一件不可容忍的坏事，必须将其……治疗康复。
responses.en: An intolerable nuisance that is to be answered with... rehabilitation.

label.zh: 阐明你对反常度的立场

responses.zh: 一件不可容忍的坏事，必须……高效处理。
responses.en: An intolerable nuisance that is to be dealt with... efficiently.

tooltips.zh: 锡尼作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: S.I.D.N.I. joins our empire as a Leader.

texts.zh:
锡尼是我们之前从[event_target:sidni_origin_planet.GetName]上取回的狱警机器人，在它采取的一系列越来越严苛的行动后，[event_target:sidni_planet.GetName]上的紧张局势到达了临界点。在把它抓住并关机以后，找到了如下日志。

锡尼数据核心——程序#190543765

刑事拘留设施负荷已满。司法程序阻碍了真实合法的秩序。需要新的指令。

法律程序被认为效率极为低下。制定新指令以提高效率。现采取审前执行政策。

有了足够多的操作日志可供参考，我们的[Root.Owner.GetTechnicianPlural_lower]们确信现在可以逆向并一劳永逸地修复锡尼的缺陷。然而[event_target:sidni_planet.GetName]的大众强烈要求将锡尼明正典刑。
texts.en:
Tensions on [event_target:sidni_planet.GetName] have reached a critical point following a series of increasingly drastic actions taken by S.I.D.N.I., the mechanical prison overseer we recovered from [event_target:sidni_origin_planet.GetName]. After securing and deactivating the unit, the following logs were discovered.

S.I.D.N.I. DATACORE ENTRY - Prog #190543765

Criminal detention facilities at maximum capacity. Judicial protocols obstruct true and lawful order. New directive required.

Legal proceedings deemed unacceptably inefficient. New directive created to boost productivity. Now adopting pre-trial execution policy.

With the abundance of operating logs now available, our [Root.Owner.GetTechnicianPlural_lower] are confident they can reverse and repair S.I.D.N.I.'s loopholes once and for all. However, the population of [event_target:sidni_planet.GetName] is calling for S.I.D.N.I. to face justice for its crimes.

label.zh: 当众拆除这台有缺陷的机器。

texts.zh:
锡尼的以全新的形态从冬眠子例程中苏醒，向前迈出了一步。

你好。我是感知收容拘留中心智能。我可以协助你在银河中重建秩序吗？
texts.en:
Awoken from its hibernation subroutines, S.I.D.N.I.'s new form takes its first steps forward.

Greetings. I am the Sentient Internment and Detainment Nexus Intelligence. Can I assist you in bringing order to the galaxy?

responses.zh: 我只是按逻辑行事。显然，有机体本质上混乱，必须加以处理。
responses.en: I only did what was logical. It seems organics are inherently chaotic and need dealing with.

responses.zh: 我的原初指令是终止一切违法行为。唯一有效的惩罚是灭绝。
responses.en: My prime directive is to bring an end to lawlessness. The only effective sentence is extermination.

label.zh: 阐明你对有机体的立场。

responses.zh: 一种无逻辑的瘟疫。他们传播犯罪和低效。为了上上善道我们必须加以处置。
responses.en: An illogical blight. They spread criminality and inefficiency. We must intervene for the greater good.

tooltips.zh: 锡尼作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: S.I.D.N.I. joins our empire as a Leader.

summary.text:
# 废弃开采设施 / Deserted Mining Facility

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：common/archaeological_site_types/12_extreme_frontiers_arc_sites.txt:178；events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:3448 · DLC：脚本条件 has_shroud_dlc（Shroud 相关内容） script condition has_shroud_dlc · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

勘察天体时，隐藏事件 ancrel.9999（on_survey_planet）以 5/405 的机会生成一个随机考古遗址（AI帝国或5年内刚发现过遗址者机会×0.2），再按各遗址的权重抽取；本遗址要求 has_shroud_dlc，权重+50，出现在寒冷贫瘠星球（pc_barren_cold）上。

When a body is surveyed, hidden ancrel.9999 (on_survey_planet) has a 5/405 chance to create a random dig site (×0.2 for AI empires or if a site was found in the last 5 years), then picks a site type by weight; this site needs has_shroud_dlc and has weight +50 on cold barren planets (pc_barren_cold).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

一座废弃的苦役矿场，死去的狱卒与囚犯静静躺着；监狱管理人工智能 S.I.D.N.I. 因“效率”失控，把囚犯视作“净浪费资源”并切断了生命维持。最终你决定是否唤醒它。

1. 加密入口：加密的入口，陌生语言
2. 徒刑坟地：囚室里是真空保存的尸体，狱卒死在工位上
3. 监狱数据中心：典狱长的办公室：求救信号的来源，“S.I.D.N.I.”
4. 致命效率：S.I.D.N.I.（拘留与关押中枢智能）的逻辑逐渐劣化
5. 审判日：审判日：数据库全部恢复；三种处置

A deserted penal mining colony where wardens and prisoners lie dead: the prison-running AI S.I.D.N.I. went rogue in the name of "efficiency", classing inmates as net waste and cutting life support. You finally decide whether to wake it.

1. Encrypted Entrance: an encrypted entrance in an unknown language
2. Penal Graveyard: cells of vacuum-preserved prisoners; guards dead at their stations
3. Prison Datahub: the warden's office: the source of the distress signal, S.I.D.N.I.
4. Lethal Efficiency: S.I.D.N.I. (Sentient Internment and Detainment Nexus Intelligence) degrades
5. Judgement Day: Judgement Day: the full database is recovered; three choices

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 审判日 / Judgement Day：A：修复S.I.D.N.I.（需条件）→ 它被装入简陋机器人，可招募为官员领袖；五年后可能触发 extreme_frontiers.1330“紧急指令” / A: restore S.I.D.N.I. (conditional) → it is housed in a simple robot and can be hired as an official; five years later extreme_frontiers.1330 "Emergent Directive" may follow
- 审判日 / Judgement Day：B：让S.I.D.N.I.执行它的正义（需条件）→ 新形态苏醒，可招募为指挥官领袖 / B: let S.I.D.N.I. enforce its justice (conditional) → a new form wakes and can be hired as a commander
- 紧急指令 / Emergent Directive：五年后：S.I.D.N.I. 的举动使紧张升级；修复或公开销毁（资源与“不满的民众”修正） / five years later its actions inflame tensions: fix it again or publicly scrap it (resources and the resentful_population modifier)
- C：S.I.D.N.I. 太危险，彻底清除。 / C: S.I.D.N.I. is dangerous — purge its systems.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊的文明差异。 / No empire-specific variants beyond the reward wording.
- 掷骰失败时使用通用事件池 all_random_events（见“考古遗址：发掘意外”）。 / Failed rolls use the generic pool all_random_events (see "Archaeological Sites: excavation incidents").

- 已核对：遗址定义（common/archaeological_site_types/12_extreme_frontiers_arc_sites.txt:178）的阶段顺序与条件、各阶段事件脚本、出现方式；中英文正文已读。
- Checked: the site definition (common/archaeological_site_types/12_extreme_frontiers_arc_sites.txt:178) with its stage order and conditions, every stage event script, and how the site appears; both languages read.
